content:
sophie-ps: Quick heads-up — Acme is asking for RBAC change + KMS evidence ahead of their enterprise review call at 10:30 PT. They want: read-only access for a service account to tenant logs, proof of key rotation (last 90d), and an auditable export showing no cross-tenant key access. Can we list deliverables?

emma-sec: Ok. Minimal artifact set we usually provide: policy snippet, role mapping screenshot, signed key-rotation events, KMS audit export (to SIEM), and a short narrative describing separation controls. Also check retention windows + redaction notes.

mike-infra: For the RBAC change: grant `role/logs.viewer` to `svc-analytics@infra` scoped to tenant namespace. Example IAM bind:```yaml
bindings:
  - role: roles/logs.viewer
    members:
      - serviceAccount:svc-analytics@infra.example.com
```
We'll also produce the terraform snippet and the console screenshot.

raj-engr: On KMS side, we can dump rotation events from the key-manager service:```bash
# list rotation events (last 90d)
redwood-kms-cli rotations list --key-id=key-tn-123 --since=90d --format=json | jq .
```
Sample event line we can include (redacted): `{"time":"2025-11-12T02:14:23Z","actor":"kms-operator","action":"rotate","key_id":"key-tn-123","prev_version":"v3","new_version":"v4","signed":true}`

dave-sre: We must be explicit about audit log retention and chain-of-custody for the export. Agreed artifacts: 1) RBAC policy + terraform + screenshot; 2) KMS rotation export (signed) for last 90d; 3) Audit log export (logs api -> compressed bundle) with a manifest and checksum; 4) Short runbook describing how we generated the export and redaction steps.

emma-sec: Note: For enterprise asks, include a statement about our key separation guarantees: customer tenant keys are generated in a tenant-scoped keystore, HSM protected, no cross-tenant mounts. We can attach the keystore separation diagram (I'll prepare).

sophie-ps: Do we have an existing evidence pack template we can reuse? Need to turn-around in ~3 hours.

raj-engr: Yes, I have a `evidence-pack` script. Example invocation:```bash
./tools/evidence-pack --tenant tn-123 --since=90d --include-rotations --redact-ips --output=acme-evidence-2025-11-12.tar.gz
# generates manifest.json + checksums + audited.log.gz + rotations.json.signed
```
I'll run it and drop artifacts to a secure share.

mike-infra: Two quick checks before we hand off: 1) confirm the svc-analytics SA has no write perms; 2) confirm log export redaction removed IPs & tokens. I'll run a spot check query:```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_logs WHERE tenant_id='tn-123' AND message LIKE '%ip=%' LIMIT 1;
```
If >0, we need to update redact pipeline.

emma-sec: Also triage note: while preparing we found a medium vuln signal flagged by vuln-scan for an older kms-client lib on one fleet node (CVE-2024-xxxx). It isn't customer-facing but we should triage. Sophie — can you open a short vuln ticket and assign to raj for patch verification? We'll mention it's unrelated to tenant isolation in the evidence pack but disclose remediation ETA.

sophie-ps: Opening ticket now. ID: SEC-2025-42. Assigning to @raj-engr. ETA for fix?

raj-engr: I'll validate reproducer and patch. If it's minor we'll push urgent patch to the infra pool within 48h.

dave-sre: For the export manifest include SHA256 checksums and a signed attest by sec-ops. Use our signing key `sec-sign-prod`. We should also capture audit log lines that show `iam.bind` operations for the SA change (include a 3-line sample). Example log snippet:```
2025-11-12T09:12:01Z iam.bind user=alice-admin action=bind target=svc-analytics@infra scope=tenant:tn-123 role=roles/logs.viewer trace=abc123
2025-11-12T09:12:05Z audit.export user=runbook-bot action=export target=logs bucket=gs://rnw-evidence-acme manifest=man-20251112.json
```

incident-bot: :rotating_light: watch: correlated alert — previous KMS rotate job failed on 2025-10-30 03:05Z for key=key-tn-987, retry succeeded 03:07Z. No customer keys affected. Incident link: https://incidents/reports/INC-2025-76

emma-sec: Good catch. We'll include a short note about the retry behavior and automatic reconciliation. Also include the SLA fallback policy (we fall back to replica key material for 5m).

sophie-ps: Action items summary: - raj: run evidence-pack + attach rotations.json.signed (due in 1h) - mike: run redact spot-check and provide query results (due in 40m) - emma: prepare keystore separation diagram + narrative (due in 2h) - dave: produce signed manifest + checksums (due in 2h) - sophie: compile evidence pack and join the call at 10:30 PT.

mike-infra: Started the redact spot-check — will paste results when ready.

raj-engr: Starting evidence-pack run now, will upload to secure share `s3://redwood-evidence/acme/1759990000/` and ping when done.

emma-sec: I'll draft the short narrative and the disclosure note for the vuln ticket. Keep language minimal and factual.

sophie-ps: Perfect — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, drop in this thread. :thumbsup:
